name: Inner Mongolia Yili Industrial Group Co., Ltd.
note: Listed in Shanghai (SSE 600887). Per its 2025 annual report (published 30 Apr 2026): Hohhot Investment Co., Ltd. (呼和浩特投资有限责任公司) is the largest shareholder with 538,535,826 shares, 8.51%, shareholder type 'state legal person' (国有法人); the company states it has no controlling shareholder and no actual controller. A minority municipal stake, a much weaker state link than the Gulf cases.
